_comment: Two independent latitude lines, each a list of (worldX -> z) control points interpolated with a uniform cubic B-spline over the 4 nearest points (see LatitudeClimate). 'ice_points' controls LatitudeIceHandler/LatitudeIcebergHandler/temperature. 'grass_points' controls the dead-grass fade in SeasonFoliageColorProvider. They are independent lines that can be edited separately. Each list must be sorted ascending by x.
